title: I just purchased license update to the latest version but Marvelous Designer won't let me login.
content: If you see the message "The license is already in use by another computer. Please deactivate the license on the other computer and try logging in again", please deactivate license from old version and try to login again. If this does not work, please contact our support team by [contact us](https://marvelousdesigner.com/support/contact)
content_description: This page provides guidance for resolving license activation issues and offers support options for further assistance.

title: Can I receive my invoice?
content: **Question** Can I receive my invoice? **Answer** Yes, you can check and print out your invoice from the Marvelous Designer website. For Personal users: 1. Go to your [License page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license) and click the "[Order History](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license/history)" button. 2. Click the "Invoice" button according to your subscription. 3. Click the "View" button to download your invoice. For Enterprise users: 1. Login with your Company ID. 2. Put your cursor over the profile icon and click the "[License Account Admin](https://marvelousdesigner.com/teamconsole)" button. 3. Click the "[Invoice](https://marvelousdesigner.com/teamconsole/invoice)" button. 4. Click the file button below to download your invoice.
content_description: Easily access and download your invoice by following the step-by-step instructions tailored for both Personal and Enterprise users on the Marvelous Designer website.

title: What is the difference between Personal and Enterprise License?
content: There is a distinction based on the user's status. All users must comply with the "[Terms of Service](https://marvelousdesigner.com/terms)." Freelancers are allowed to use personal licenses, but all other companies (studios, game companies, research companies, etc.) must purchase enterprise licenses. If a corporate entity purchases personal licenses, access to the purchased Marvelous Designer license may be restricted or terminated without prior notice. If a personal license is purchased using a company's credit card or company email address, it may be considered as a purchase by a corporate customer.
content_description: This page outlines the licensing requirements for users of Marvelous Designer, emphasizing the distinction between freelancers and corporate entities regarding personal and enterprise licenses.

title: How can I get a trial version of Marvelous Designer?
content: ## **For personal users:** Yes, we provide a 14-days free trial. Check our **[Trial page](https://marvelousdesigner.com/pricing/trial)** for more information. * The trial is available for a one-time use. * When the trial expires, your monthly subscription will be automatically charged. If you do not wish to proceed with the subscription payment, please cancel it on the [license page](https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license). ## **For Enterprise users:** Please send the request through [sales@marvelousdesigner.com](https://sales@marvelousdesigner.com). A representative will respond within 2-3 business days.
content_description: Discover our 14-day free trial for personal users and learn how enterprise users can request tailored assistance, all designed to help you experience the benefits of Marvelous Designer.

title: There is another similar software called CLO, what is the difference?
content: We have two different products called Marvelous Designer and CLO that have been specifically designed for the entertainment and fashion industries, respectively. While similar, CLO is equipped with additional features that are essential to fashion designers including avatar size adjustability and support for DXF-AAMA (drawing) files. On the other hand, Marvelous Designer including UV editor, sculpt mode Other features unique to CLO are: The ability to measure the avatar as a tailor would, tech pack (specifications) feature, diverse stitching visuals, and advanced CAD features. To learn more about CLO, please visit [www.clo3d.com](https://www.clo3d.com/)
content_description: Discover the unique features and applications of Marvelous Designer and CLO, two innovative tools tailored for the entertainment and fashion industries, respectively.
